messages: anya: heads up: prod docs build is throwing 404s for deep links to /guides/setup/ (works locally) — noticed after mkdocs->docusaurus migration :grimacing: docs-bot: [ci] build failed for branch 'main' — check logs: https://ci.internal/reports/2465011111 sam: any repro steps? I can take a look anya: go to https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/setup/#deploy-targets — clicking the heading jumps to top, not anchor liam: I saw this too. problem seems to be encoded slashes in filenames (eg `getting-started/01_setup.md` -> slug includes `/`), mkdocs had different slug rules sam: can you paste failing HTML fragment? I grabbed this from the build: ```Deploy targets``` which should work but produced 404 because build emitted `guides/setup/index.html` vs `guides/setup.html` taylor: hmm. we're using permalink config that strips index.html; maybe the server rewrites didn't carry over anya: also images inside that folder with relative paths `./assets/diagram.png` end up with broken paths when breadcrumbed liam: quick mitigation: normalize internal link targets to use trailing slash canonical form. I can open a PR to rewrite links during build step and add tests sam: would prefer to fix generator rules rather than rewrite pages, but short-term PR is fine. please include unit for `slugify('Getting Started / 01_setup') -> 'guides/getting-started/'` liam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-site/pull/6123 — fixes slug rules + adds link normalization + test docs-bot: PR 6123 triggered preview build: https://deploy-preview-6123.docs.redwood.ai — preview shows anchors working :thumbsup: taylor: timeline? can we merge before the afternoon release? need to avoid breaking mobile deep links anya: if preview looks good ✅ I'd like a patch release. Sam — can you sanity-check the canonical URL rewrite in nginx conf? it's in infra/docs-nginx.conf sam: I will. also checking for percent-encoding issues for non-ascii headings liam: added e2e test for a non-ascii anchor (`"café & co" -> café-and-co`), passes locally anya: thanks. once sam signs off, I'll merge and schedule minor deploy. leave a note in release notes: "docs: fix deep link anchors and image relpaths" taylor: add migration note in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md about slug rules so future contributors know anya: will do. assigning follow-ups: sam -> nginx check, taylor -> release timing, liam -> monitor post-merge, anya -> update contrib sam: on it :eyes: liam: post-merge monitor: I'll run linkcheck job for 24h and watch Sentry alerts anya: great. closing thread — thanks everyone :rocket:
